proto-desc: The 1.2 prototype: shows its switch and what it changes. Subcommands: on, off, status
proto-status-desc: Shows the prototype's switch and each setting it stands in for
proto-on-desc: Switches the prototype on (saved to the settings file as proto.enabled)
proto-off-desc: Switches the prototype off: every setting takes the file's value again
proto-switched-on: The prototype is on: {0} setting(s) stand in for the file's. Walkers already in their true form keep their health until they next shift, and a walker that died before keeps its return day. /walkers proto shows each value.
proto-switched-off: The prototype is off: every setting has the file's value again.
